race.comment: JIMMYINTHEJUNGLE (3) has a handy record over this course and distance with a win and a second from two attempts and will be at peak fitness now third run back from the break. Gets some weight relief with the 2kg claim and should be right there at the business end. I'M LUCKY TWO (7) saves his best form for this circuit with two wins and two placings from six spins. Strips fitter second-up and is nicely placed to play a pivotal role. TERRITORY ASH (8) doesn't win out of turn but has hit the top-four at the past four outings and will be better for that first-up effort. One for the exotics. DRUMS OF WAR (4) just missed the frame here at the latest outing and may earn some minor money again. BEACHSIDE BABE (11) best of the rest from the inside marble.
